RADIUS
Description
These iRules commands deal specifically with the RADIUS protocol
Command List
radius_authenticate
- creates and sends a RADIUS access request message and returns the result
RADIUS::avp
- Return or add/change/remove
RADIUS av pairs
RADIUS::code
- Returns the RADIUS message
code
RADIUS::id
- Returns the RADIUS message id
RADIUS::rtdom
- Overwrites the default RD
ID in RADIUS scenario
